_comment: Settings for the copy of the application the pipeline starts to run the browser-driven suite against (ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=ci). Nothing here is a secret: the identity values are placeholders that never sign anyone in, and the content source and the assessments service point at tests/FipsFrontend.Tests.StubCmsApi; the application makes no other outbound call. The same file serves a local run of the published output under the same environment name.

Airtable._comment: The feedback form posts to the stub, which answers 200, so the suite can see the form succeed.

RateLimiting._comment: The browser suite drives this copy from one host at seconds-scale waits, which the default 100 a minute refuses part-way through a run.
